recommendations.title: Persist Proxy Dispatcher Cache Across Restarts
recommendations.current: proxyDispatchers Map is in-memory, resets on process restart; max size 20 via MEMORY_CONFIG.proxyDispatchersMaxSize
recommendations.proposed: Add SQLite or localStorage-backed dispatcher cache; populate on startup from persistent store; update on each use; TTL-based invalidation; expose via /api/proxy-pools cache status

recommendations.title: Make FETCH_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS Configurable via Env Vars
recommendations.proposed: Keep existing env var pattern; document in .env.example; ensure all executors use the re-exported constant (verified: qoder.js, bedrock.js, base.js, grok-cli.js already use it)

recommendations.title: Increase DNS Cache TTL for Production Workloads
recommendations.proposed: Increase to 10 minutes (10 * 60 * 1000) or make configurable via env var DNS_CACHE_TTL_MS; add monitoring for cache hit/miss ratio

recommendations.title: Add Health Check Endpoint /api/health
recommendations.current: No health endpoint exists; proxy status must be inferred from logs or manual checks
recommendations.proposed: Create route returning JSON: { proxyEnabled, proxyType, proxyUrl, dispatcherCount, dnsCacheSize, strictProxy, pendingRequestCount, errorBudgetRemaining, activeAccountsPerProvider, fetchConnectTimeoutMs, streamStallTimeoutMs }

recommendations.title: Implement Proxy Pool Usage Metrics
recommendations.current: No per-pool metrics tracked; round-robin/random selection without visibility into usage
recommendations.proposed: Add usage counters to proxy_pools DB table: requestCount, byteCount, consecutiveFailures, lastFailureTimestamp; increment on fetchWithTlsFallback call; expose via /api/proxy-pools?includeUsage=true; add alerting on overused/underused pools

recommendations.title: Configure Undici Agent Keep-Alive Settings
recommendations.current: No explicit Agent configuration; relying on undici defaults; proxyDispatchersMaxSize: 20
recommendations.proposed: Configure undici Agent with { timeout: 30000, keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsec: 10000, maxSockets: 50 } for direct connections; add configurable maxSockets per proxy pool type; document in runtimeConfig

recommendations.title: Add Concurrent Request Limit Per Proxy Pool
recommendations.current: No per-pool concurrent request limit; single busy pool could starve others
recommendations.proposed: Add semaphore/concurrent request counter per proxy pool; increment on fetch start, decrement on completion; reject/queue when limit exceeded (configurable per pool, default 10); prevent single-pool overload

recommendations.title: Implement Connection Draining on Proxy Pool Disable
recommendations.current: Env var clear is immediate on proxy disable; in-flight requests may abruptly switch to direct
recommendations.proposed: Add grace period or in-flight request tracking; on proxy disable, wait for pending requests to complete or timeout before clearing env vars; add /api/proxy-pools/drain endpoint

recommendations.title: Document Proxy URL Scheme Formats
recommendations.current: ALLOWED_PROXY_SCHEMES defined in outboundProxy.js; validated but not documented for operators
recommendations.proposed: Add section to README or docs/proxy.md with examples for each type: http://host:port, https://host:port, socks5://host:port, socks4://host:port, socks5h://host:port, socks4a://port; add validation error messages with allowed schemes list

recommendations.title: Set strictProxy Default to False with Opt-In
recommendations.current: strictProxy defaults based on DB value; no explicit default in code path
recommendations.proposed: Ensure strictProxy defaults to false in DB schema and API; add warning in UI when strictProxy is enabled; explicit opt-in required for sensitive deployments

recommendations.title: Add Proxy Rotation Scheduling
recommendations.current: Manual rotation via API; round-robin index resets on restart
recommendations.proposed: Add scheduled job (cron) that rotates round-robin index daily/weekly; add auto-rotate flag on proxy pool configuration; persist rotation state in DB

recommendations.title: Increase DNS Cache TTL Configurability
recommendations.current: dnsCacheTtlMs hardcoded in MEMORY_CONFIG as 5 minutes; readable via envMs but not exposed
recommendations.proposed: Make dnsCacheTtlMs fully configurable via env var DNS_CACHE_TTL_MS with 5min default; add monitoring for cache hit/miss ratio; expose in health endpoint

recommendations.title: Add MITM Bypass Host List Documentation
recommendations.current: MITM_BYPASS_HOSTS array with 6 hosts; no documentation on why these hosts or how to add entries
recommendations.proposed: Add section to docs explaining: these are all public-CA-issued targets; TLS verification works without extra trust; add new hosts as needed (must have valid public certs); document the DNS spoofing risk that motivates this bypass

recommendations.title: Persist Proxy Pool Rotation State Across Restarts
recommendations.current: rotateState Map is in-memory, resets on process restart; providerId → { index } for round-robin
recommendations.proposed: Persist rotation index to DB; populate on startup from DB; update on each use; enables consistent round-robin across restarts; add health endpoint to view rotation state

recommendations.title: Add Proxy Fallback Metrics and Alerting
recommendations.current: Proxy failures logged via console.warn; no structured metrics on fallback frequency
recommendations.proposed: Track proxy failure counts per pool type; track fallback-to-direct frequency; add Prometheus metrics or health endpoint counters; alert on sudden increase in fallback rate (indicates proxy degradation)
